# Picsart's New AI Tools Explained: Video, Voice, Images and Claude

> **In short:** Picsart has added several AI tools at once. Seedance 2.5 Flash makes quicker, lower-cost video tests, MiniMax H3 Image builds visuals from up to 16 reference images, GPT-Live adds voice to Picsart AI Agents, and a connector lets Claude hand video production to Picsart. Each one covers a different stage of a creative project.

If you have ever wanted to make a short video, a poster or a pitch without starting from a blank page, this bundle of updates is worth a look. The tools arrived close together, but they do not all do the same job. Once you see which stage each one helps with, they are easier to use.

## Test ideas cheaply with Seedance 2.5 Flash

Most video projects go through many rough versions before anything is ready to post. A camera move needs another try, a line of dialogue lands wrong, or a product looks too small in the frame.

Seedance 2.5 Flash is the faster version of Seedance 2.5, a video model from ByteDance. Picsart says it is built for this early testing stage, when speed and cost matter more than top quality. It creates clips from 4 to 30 seconds, with sound included, at 480p or 720p (the numbers describe the picture's sharpness). Picsart says the model is available in its AI Playground, where you can try ideas before choosing a final version.

Think of it as a sketchpad. You try a slow camera move, then a faster one, then the same shot with no music. Keep what works and drop the rest. When you want a sharper final render, Picsart's notes suggest the full Seedance 2.5 model, which supports higher resolution and a feature called Draft Mode (a rough, quick preview).

## Build visuals from your own pictures with MiniMax H3 Image

A text prompt (the written instruction you type to the AI) can be hard to get exactly right. Describing a specific product, a face or a color mood in words often misses the mark.

MiniMax H3 Image takes a different approach. You upload up to 16 reference images, which are photos that show the AI what you want. Picsart says you can then add a prompt and get finished visuals in up to 4K resolution, and keep editing them with the same model. MiniMax describes this as its first model for still images.

One photo can supply the product, another the lighting, and a third the setting. Your prompt explains how to combine them. This is useful for a small shop posting new products, a home cook planning a recipe card, or a student designing a poster.

## Talk through a project with GPT-Live

GPT-Live is OpenAI's live voice technology. Picsart says it now powers voice in Picsart AI Agents, which are assistants that handle creative tasks for you. You can speak to the agent, hear it reply, and keep working while the task runs in the background. Picsart notes that a task can keep going after you end the call, and you can come back when the results are ready.

This suits rough ideas. Saying "I'm thinking of a calm coffee brand" out loud is often easier than writing a precise brief.

## Let Claude direct a whole video through Picsart MCP

MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard that lets AI apps connect to outside tools, like a plug for an appliance) links Claude to Picsart's image, video and audio generation. Picsart's guide describes Claude as the researcher and writer, and Picsart as the production studio that renders the animated scenes and voiceover. The setup uses a custom connector, and Picsart says the guide expects a Pro or Max Claude plan.

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life**: Use voice to brainstorm a birthday video or a family slideshow, then generate a short clip to see if the idea works.
- **For your business or work**: Test several product-video directions with Seedance 2.5 Flash before paying for a final render, and build a consistent product set with MiniMax H3 Image.
- **If you're just getting started**: Begin with one tool and one small project, such as a 4-second clip or a single poster. Small tests teach you more than a big plan.
- **If you already use it**: Combine references in MiniMax H3 Image with a short Seedance test, so your visuals and motion stay in the same style from the start.

## Wrap-up

Picsart's updates cover testing (Seedance 2.5 Flash), image building (MiniMax H3 Image), spoken brainstorming (GPT-Live) and full video production through Claude (Picsart MCP). Pick the stage you are stuck on today. Open Picsart's AI Playground, check the official pricing page for current plan details, and try one short test to see how it fits your project.
